verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an authentication and user-management service, but the pack contains no evidence that Clerk can be self-hosted. The "deploy to your own domain" line is custom-domain branding, the open-source GitHub repo and migration tool are client SDKs and import utilities, and all features run against Clerk's hosted Backend API. Community comments contrast Clerk with alternatives that store auth data in your own database, which is consistent with no self-host option but not proof of one.
